## Before you submit

Do **not** attach your private notes, screenshots showing them, absolute local paths, or
files from `.tessarios/` without reading and redacting them first. A small made-up example
that shows the problem is better than the real one.

For a suspected security issue, do not use this template. Follow `SECURITY.md`.
